 to help define what AI filmmaking can become with Autodesk Flow Studio. This is a rare opportunity to shape both the creative direction of the product itself and the films, experiments, demos, and cultural moments that show the world what it can do.
   

  

 This is an AI\-first, hands\-on creative leadership role embedded within the Flow Studio Product organization. You’ll have significant creative freedom, lead a dedicated content team, work closely with Product leadership, and get hands\-on with emerging AI filmmaking tools and workflows. The work can range from ambitious cinematic showcases and AI films to fast\-moving social experiments designed to earn attention organically.
   

  

 You’ll own the creative bar for everything that lives in or represents the product: the creative look and feel of key product surfaces, cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, templates and examples, demos, launch storytelling, and other content that helps creators understand what Flow Studio can make possible.
   

  

 You’ll also be the primary product\-side creative partner to Flow Studio Marketing, helping shape concepts, promos, launch videos, campaigns, social content, and other external storytelling. Marketing leads audience, campaign, channel, and brand strategy; this role brings the product’s creative vision, AI filmmaking expertise, cinematic taste, and product truth into the work.

* Own the creative vision and quality bar for Flow Studio across in\-product creative experiences, cinematic content, libraries, demos, showcases, and product storytelling.
* Lead and develop the Flow Studio content team, setting creative priorities, directing execution, mentoring contributors, and building a team capable of producing exceptional work quickly.

* Exceptional portfolio or reel demonstrating outstanding cinematic taste, storytelling, and creative direction.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with AI filmmaking and modern generative creative tools, with a strong understanding of the rapidly evolving image, video, performance, animation, and AI production landscape.
* Strong filmmaking instincts across camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, and visual storytelling. Cinematography or directing experience is a major plus.
* Proven ability to originate and create ambitious cinematic work—not only manage or review the work of others.
* Strong understanding of viral, social, and internet\-native content, with sharp awareness of emerging social media trends, formats, platforms, and online culture. Demonstrated experience creating or directing work that has earned meaningful organic reach, audience engagement, or cultural traction.
* Experience leading creative teams, giving direct and constructive feedback, and maintaining a consistently high creative bar.
* Comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams and turning emerging technology and complex product capabilities into compelling creative ideas, demonstrations, and experiences.


 What Success Looks Like

* New product capabilities become films, demos, experiments, and creative experiences that make people immediately understand—and want to try—what Flow Studio can do.
* The content team becomes a fast, ambitious creative engine that can produce both high\-end cinematic work and culturally relevant, internet\-native experiments.

title: Creative Director, Partnerships & Collectibles
description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.
   

  

**Overview**
 Crocs is seeking a
 **Creative Director, Partnerships and Collectibles** 
 to lead the creative vision and execution behind brand collaborations, limited\-edition drops, and collectible storytelling that connect with culture in unexpected ways. Reporting to the Vice President, Global Creative, this role will define how Crocs shows up alongside brands, talent, and cultural voices, creating ideas that balance multiple perspectives while ensuring every partnership feels authentic, additive, and unmistakably Crocs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a visionary leader and systems thinker who can build creative concepts that extend across product, packaging, campaign storytelling, e\-commerce, visual merchandising, and experience. They are deeply inspired by culture, design, and craft, with a passion for bringing different worlds together through innovative storytelling and collectible experiences. Comfortable navigating complexity across teams, partners, and priorities, this leader maintains clarity of vision while delivering thoughtful, culturally relevant work that reflects Crocs' Wonderfully Unordinary spirit.This role leads a multidisciplinary team responsible for the full creative expression of partnerships, from campaign development across film and photography to packaging, product storytelling, e\-commerce, and retail experiences.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
* Lead with vision: Define the creative direction for partnerships and collectibles, ensuring every collaboration feels balanced, intentional, and brand\-right
* Build ideas in partnership: Develop concepts that bring two brands together in harmony, creating something new without compromising either identity
* Own the full expression: Oversee creative across campaigns, film, photography, packaging, e\-commerce, and retail environments
* Champion storytelling: Translate partnership strategy into compelling narratives that drive cultural relevance and consumer excitement
* Design for product and drop culture: Shape how collaborations come to life through packaging, collectibles, and in\-hand experiences
* Lead and inspire teams: Guide a multidisciplinary team across art direction, design, and copy, setting a high bar for both thinking and execution
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Merchandising, and external collaborators to align creative with business and cultural opportunity
* Drive craft and consistency: Ensure all outputs reflect a high level of quality, cohesion, and attention to detail across every touchpoint
* Navigate complexity: Manage multiple partners, timelines, and expectations while maintaining creative clarity and momentum
* Present with impact: Communicate ideas and creative direction confidently to internal leadership and external partners
* Stay culturally attuned: Bring awareness of trends, collaborators, and cultural movements to identify meaningful partnership opportunities
* Experiment with new tools: Stay curious and open to innovation — exploring how AI, emerging technology, and evolving creative processes can unlock new ways to tell stories and create at scale


****What You'll Bring to the Table****
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience
* At least 10\+ years of experience in creative roles across brand, agency, or in\-house teams
* At least 3\+ years leading and developing creative teams
* Strong experience in brand collaborations, partnerships, or cultural marketing
* Proven ability to lead work across campaigns, packaging, retail, and digital touchpoints
* Expert\-level art direction, design, and or copywriting skills
* Strong storytelling and concept development abilities
* Experience working with external partners, collaborators, and talent
* Ability to manage complex projects with multiple collaborators
* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to craft across all outputs
* Understanding of consumer insights, trends, and cultural dynamics


 The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

title: Executive Brand Director
description:
**Executive Brand Director** 




  





 Conscious Minds is an independent creative agency that helps brands establish a more human connection between brands and their audiences. We have offices in Pasadena, CA, and Portland, OR, and offer a remote\-first work environment to our employees. Our clients include Apple, Mars Petcare, Meta, Nike, Oakley, Starbucks, Uber Eats, Vans, Yahoo, and Zillow.
 



  





 We’re a people\-first work culture, big on community, trust, transparency, and respect for one another. We operate as an integrated team from Strategy through Production—and everything in between.
 



  





 We are currently looking for a full\-time Executive Brand Director.
 



  





 Location: West Coast preferred // PST hours required

*\*\*This role requires travel 1\-3x per month* 




  





**ABOUT THIS ROLE** 




 We're looking for an Executive Brand Director who thrives at the intersection of business strategy, creative excellence, and client partnership.
 



 This is a highly influential leadership role responsible for shaping strategic direction across multiple accounts, mentoring multidisciplinary teams, growing client relationships, and ensuring every piece of work delivers measurable business impact.
 



  





 The Executive Brand Director will report to the Brand Principal.
 



  





**Strategic Leadership** 



* Lead brand strategy across a portfolio of Fortune 500 clients.
* Translate complex business challenges into clear creative opportunities.
* Build brand positioning, messaging frameworks, campaign platforms, and long\-term marketing roadmaps.
* Identify emerging cultural trends and consumer behaviors that create competitive advantage.
* Guide annual planning, innovation initiatives, and integrated marketing strategies.

* Serve as executive strategic lead for key client relationships.
* Build trusted partnerships with senior marketing leadership.
* Lead executive presentations, workshops, and strategic planning sessions.
* Influence client decisions through thoughtful insights and compelling storytelling.
* Identify opportunities for account growth and new business expansion.



  





**Creative Leadership** 



* Partner closely with Executive Creative Directors, Creative Directors, and Production leadership.
* Ensure every creative concept aligns with strategic objectives.
* Champion breakthrough thinking while maintaining business rigor.
* Elevate creative quality across campaigns, social content, experiential, and integrated marketing.

* Mentor Brand Directors, Strategists, Account Leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Foster collaboration across Strategy, Creative, Production, Social, and Client Services.
* Create an environment where diverse perspectives lead to stronger ideas.

* Lead strategic components of new business pitches.
* Develop agency thought leadership and intellectual property.
* Help shape agency service offerings and future capabilities.
* Partner with executive leadership on agency growth initiatives.



  





**REQUIREMENTS:** 



* 12\+ years in brand strategy, integrated marketing, or creative agency leadership.
* Experience leading Fortune 500 or global consumer brands.
* Deep understanding of social\-first marketing and digital ecosystems.
* Strong background in integrated campaigns spanning paid, owned, earned, experiential, and influencer.
* Proven success leading executive\-level client relationships.
* Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams in fast\-paced agency environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.



  





**You're Someone Who...** 



* Thinks like a strategist and inspires like a creative.
* Understands both culture and commerce.
* Knows how to simplify complexity.
* Builds trust quickly with clients and teams.
* Gives clear, actionable feedback.
* Thrives in ambiguity and brings clarity to every challenge.
* Pushes work beyond expectations while supporting the people behind it.
* Leads with curiosity, empathy, and accountability.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* Experience with technology, CPG, retail, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
* Background in social\-first agencies.
* Experience with creator marketing and influencer ecosystems.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered creative workflows and emerging marketing technologies.
* Experience leading global or multi\-market campaigns.



  





 We are one of the most personal, hands\-on, and creative companies in this industry. We are extremely high touch with our partners, team members, and creatives to ensure clarity, community, and output exceed expectations. Above all, we want versatile people with unique and diverse points of view who add meaningful value to the DNA of Conscious Minds and the brands we work with. We look forward to the opportunity of having you on the squad, growing the influence and profile of our team.
 



  





**BENEFITS** 



* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Training \& Development
* Work From Home/Hybrid Days



  





**The anticipated annual compensation range for this position is $145,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00, in addition to our standard employee benefits package (medical/dental/vision/life insurance, 401k matching, Flexible PTO, and various other benefits and perks) Consistent with applicable law, compensation is determined based on a wide range of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, job duties, and geographic location. We reserve the right to modify this pay range at any time.**

title: Brand Director, Global Marc Jacobs
description:

**New York, NY** 




  





**THE ROLE** 




**COTY is looking for smart leaders who are tenacious, passionate, and fearlessly kind.** 




  





**What You Will Do:** 




 The
 **Global Marketing Director, Marc Jacobs Fragrances** 
 will own together with the Vice President of Global marketing, the strategic leadership of the global fragrance marketing agenda: shaping brand vision, orchestrating long\-term growth initiatives, driving cross\-region alignment and championing the brand’s global footprint. This role combines deep fragrance category expertise, P\&L ownership, team leadership and global execution excellence. The successful candidate will translate global brand ambitions into high\-impact programs that deliver business results across markets.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



* Define and lead the global fragrance marketing vision and strategy, encompassing brand architecture, global consumer segmentation, positioning across regions, innovation roadmap, and long\-term growth platforms.
* Strongly influence the global fragrance portfolio’s P\&L, including revenue growth, margin management, COGs and marketing spend, setting investment priorities.
* Manage and develop a high\-performing marketing organization fostering talent development, cross\-functional collaboration and consistent brand execution worldwide.
* Oversee the planning and execution of the global product launch calendar for fragrances—concept development, fragrance, naming \& packaging strategy, 360 campaigns and global go\-to\-market.
* Drive omnichannel global marketing campaigns (360°): advertising, digital/social, influencer strategy, experiential, retail activations, e\-commerce, sampling and GWP (Gift With Purchase)—ensuring global scale and local relevance.
* Maintain deep consumer and market insights across the fragrance category globally: trend analysis, competitive benchmarking, country/regional dynamics, consumer journey mapping, identifying white\-space opportunities.
* Ensure global brand consistency while enabling regional/local market customization and adaptations—balancing global standards with local market needs.
* Own the development of strategic communications and deliverables: global business reviews, board\-level decks, agency briefs, internal/external presentations, and marketing toolkits for regional teams.
* Drive the creation and governance of commercial tools and initiatives: global frameworks for GWPs, sampling programs, promotional sets, seasonal activations and merchandising—ensuring they align with brand equity, deliver ROI and support key milestones.
* Lead cross\-functional partnerships (R\&D/Olfactive, Supply Chain, Trade Marketing, Legal/Regulatory, Licensor) to ensure seamless alignment of marketing strategy with brand DNA.
* Lead the relationship with the licensor, serving as the primary point of contact to secure timely approvals, ensure brand alignment, and maintain strong collaboration across projects. Proactively manage communication, timelines, and expectations to keep all initiatives on track and compliant with brand standards.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business or related field; MBA preferred.
* 9\+ years of marketing experience, with at least several years in a senior role within the fragrance, beauty or luxury goods sector.
* Proven track record of leading global campaigns, product launches and fragrance business growth.
* Strong strategic, commercial and analytical acumen; experience managing budgets, P\&L, forecasting and ROI.
* Deep understanding of the fragrance category—including consumer behavior, olfactive trends, regional market dynamics and retail channels.
* Outstanding leadership and people\-management skills; experienced in managing global \& marketing teams and agency partners.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills—able to influence senior leadership and external stakeholders.
* Passion for fragrance, sensory experience, brand storytelling and innovation.
* Global mindset with the ability to navigate diverse markets, build consensus and create trustworthy relationships.
* Highly organized, adaptable, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and familiar with marketing analytics/tools.



  





**What We Offer**

 Coty’s global omni\-working policy provides the option to work up to 50% of your month remotely. We believe that a flexible philosophy of remote working gives everyone the freedom to choose what works for their individual circumstances and empowers them to always perform at their best.

title: Visual Design Director
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a visionary leader to define the visual aesthetic of the Nutanix product portfolio and transform the way our Visual Design team operates in the age of AI. As the Visual Design Director, you will hold a high\-impact leadership role within the User Experience Design organization. Your mission is to elevate our brand within the product experience, leading the evolution of our comprehensive design system, illustration library, motion design, and overall aesthetic strategy. You and your team will transform complex technical concepts into intuitive, beautiful, and world\-class digital experiences that set the industry standard for enterprise software.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will join a global, multidisciplinary design organization that includes Visual Designers, UX Designers, UX Researchers, UX Engineers and more. We are a passionate group of creators dedicated to bringing elegance and simplicity to powerful, technically complex systems. At Nutanix, we make cloud computing simple, and we achieve this through relentless focus on the user and a commitment to delivering high quality, consumer\-grade design.
   

  

 In this role, you will report to the Senior Director of Design, a leader who values a strong design acumen, people centric leadership, and effective cross functional collaboration. Our team operates with a strong bias for action, valuing "doing" over "saying," and we pride ourselves on driving ambitious projects to closure.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Build and scale a high\-performing, inclusive, and diverse visual design team that spans across multiple geographies.
* Reimagine our visual design practice with the latest AI technologies and tooling.
* Deliver a scalable and accessible design system in close partnership with engineering.
* Craft and execute a long\-term vision for the Visual Design function that aligns with business objectives.
* Drive a compelling visual vision that brings clarity, usability, and competitive differentiation to Nutanix products.
* Lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team (visual, illustration, motion) to reach new heights of creativity.
* Advocate for the value of visual design at all levels of the organization.
* Apply up\-to\-date knowledge of current design trends and emerging technologies to keep Nutanix at the forefront of the industry.
* Engage meaningfully with engineering teams on implementation feasibility within a highly technical environment.
* Elevate design quality across the Nutanix product portfolio.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure a seamless "one\-brand" experience.
* Establish a strong team identity and culture that attracts top\-tier talent.
* Mentor and develop designers to succeed in enterprise environments, fostering both technical proficiency and soft skills.
* Exhibit a high "say vs. do" ratio; removing roadblocks and resolving cross\-functional dependencies to drive projects to conclusion.


**What You Will Bring**
* Design Expertise: A strong design sensibility with a professional background in Visual Design, Graphic Design, or a related creative field.
* Proven Leadership: Extensive experience leading, managing and scaling teams of creative professionals in a fast\-paced environment.
* Mastery of UI design, typography, color theory, layout, hierarchy, etc.
* Deep experience producing, managing, and scaling enterprise\-grade design systems.
* An obsession with detail and a passion for high\-fidelity execution.
* A mature leadership style with the ability to drive alignment across diverse engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.
* Inclusivity: Strong experience with web accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design principles.
* Enterprise Experience: Familiarity with cloud computing or similarly complex technical domains is a significant plus.


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
   

  

 The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $243,000 and USD $486,000 per year.
   

  

 However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign\-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
   

  

 If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

**Qualifications** **REQUIREMENTS:**

description:
#### **About Stark**


Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road\-legal VARG EX \& SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.


We’re based in Sant Boi, Barcelona, growing fast (77% year\-on\-year), and building a team that will take us even further. If you want to work on a product that people are genuinely obsessed with, this is it.


Stark will become the global market leader in premium motorcycles. Building premium motorcycles requires innovation and we need your help to make us succeed


Our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry, by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.


This will be achieved by building sustainable products that are superior to traditional technology in terms of Performance, Emotion and Design.

#### **The Role**


This isn't just a procurement role; it is a strategic position requiring a deep understanding of the global electronics ecosystem. You will be responsible for navigating the complexities of semiconductor cycles, managing relationships with top\-tier manufacturers, and identifying technical opportunities within our designs to optimize the supply chain.


You will report directly to the Purchasing Director and work as a bridge between Engineering and the global market to ensure our motorcycles remain at the cutting edge of electric performance.

#### **What You’ll Do**

* **Strategic Sourcing:** Navigate the global electronics manufacturing supplier landscape (EMS, Electronic Components Manufacturers \& Worldwide Electronics Distributors) to secure best\-in\-class partnerships.
* **Market Intelligence:** Act as the internal expert on semiconductor trends, memory market volatility, and global supply/demand shifts to proactively mitigate risk.
* **Technical Portfolio Discovery:** Review internal designs and technical portfolios to identify new manufacturers and alternative components (pin\-to\-pin or functional equivalents) that offer better lead times or cost\-efficiency.
* **Relationship Management:** Build and leverage high\-level relationships with major component manufacturers and global distributors
* **Commercial Ownership:** Manage RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs; negotiate Master Purchase Agreements that protect Stark’s agility in a volatile market.
* **Cost \& Inventory Control:** Drive aggressive cost\-reduction activities and "total cost of ownership" models without compromising the technical integrity of our assemblies.
* **Cross\-Functional Engineering Support:** Act as a technical consultant to the Engineering team during the design phase to ensure "design\-for\-availability."

#### **What you will bring to Stark**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of senior sourcing experience, specifically focused on **Electronic Components and** **assemblies.**
* **Education:** **Electronics Engineer** (highly valuable) or a technical degree with significant experience in electronics manufacturing.
* **Global Landscape Expertise:** Deep knowledge of the global semiconductor players (Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, NXP, Analog Devices, Rohm, Infineon, Murata, etc.) and the wider distribution network.
* **Technical Discernment:** The ability to read a schematic or BOM and detect opportunities for supplier diversification or technical optimization.
* **Negotiation Prowess:** A skilled negotiator who understands the nuances of the electronics industry, from NRE costs to volume rebates and buffer stock agreements.
* **Mindset:** Results\-oriented, highly analytical, and passionate about sustainability.
* **Communication:** Fluent in English (must) and Spanish (highly desired).

#### **Why work with us?**

* The chance to work on a product people are genuinely passionate about
* A fast\-growing company with real momentum
* A creative, international team based in Barcelona
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Direct access to riders, race teams, and the product — this is not a remote\-from\-the\-product role
* Subsidized lunch in our in house restaurant
* Free access to our in\-house gym (including weekends!)
* 30 days of paid vacation

**At Stark, we don’t just accept difference—we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.**


We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurodiversity, or disability, feels a true sense of belonging. We believe that diverse teams make better decisions and that a culture of equity is a prerequisite for innovation.

title: Marketing Director
description:
About Graitec Group:

Graitec is a global leader in Building Information Modeling (BIM) solutions, designing and developing software that helps architects, engineers, and manufacturers design smarter and better. With over 30 years of innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit, we’ve tripled our revenue in just five years.

  

Our North Star is clear — accelerate the digital transformation of the AECO industry and model the future. We achieve this by growing our recurring revenue through innovative software and services that drive adoption, integration, and lasting value for our customers.

  

Our 800 experts across 30\+ offices in 12 countries support more than 270,000 users worldwide. As a global Autodesk Platinum Partner, we combine world\-class partnerships with our own cutting\-edge software and services to drive performance and sustainability across the industry.

  

At Graitec, we move fast and think big. We collaborate across teams and borders, embrace diversity, and challenge ourselves to innovate every day. We believe in doing the right thing, breaking down silos, and making an impact together.

 **How we work:** Growth, Agility, Innovation, Responsibility  

**How we behave:** Ambition, Engagement, One Graitec, Positive Energy  

**Learn more about the Graitec Group:** graitec\-group.com/graitec\-a\-global\-player


About the Team Hiring:

The Campaign Execution team is the operational engine of Graitec's Growth Marketing function. We translate marketing strategy into always\-on, measurable programs that generate pipeline and drive revenue across 13 countries. The team spans marketing automation, content, email execution, program operations, and global campaign delivery.

  

Graitec is 40 years old and moving faster than ever. We are transitioning from a leading Autodesk reseller into a global IP software company — and marketing is central to that transformation. We have brand presence, a large customer base, and a growing product portfolio. What we need now is the execution infrastructure to convert that into predictable, scalable pipeline.

  

This role exists because we are ready to move beyond campaigns. We run programs — launches, events, seasonal pushes — and we run them well. But we have not yet built the always\-on growth engine that compounds over time: the lifecycle programs that never stop nurturing, the automation plays that respond to buyer signals in real time, and the performance loop that tells us what to scale and what to cut. That is what this Director helps build.


Overview:
* The Marketing Director (Global Campaign Execution) builds and leads the global marketing execution engine that converts audience engagement into qualified pipeline — evolving Graitec from discrete campaigns to always\-on, AI\-enabled growth programs that compound over time.
* Reporting to the VP, Global Growth Marketing, the Director leads a team of five and partners across Growth Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Solutions Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Revenue Operations. The VP sets strategy and organizational direction; this role owns the always\-on execution engine and is accountable for its pipeline contribution.

 **Always\-On Growth Engine:**

* In partnership with the VP, help drive the transition from building campaigns from scratch each quarter to running programs that are always on — spending team time improving what works rather than restarting from zero.
* Design and build full\-funnel lifecycle programs — acquisition, activation, expansion, retention — that run continuously and compound over time.
* Manage the operating model within the strategic direction set by the VP — campaign frameworks, channel mix execution, audience segmentation, and the feedback loops that drive optimization  

Use AI tools to accelerate personalization, content generation, campaign testing, and performance analysis at scale.

 **Campaign Orchestration \& Pipeline Acceleration:**

* Execute against campaign strategy set by the VP and Corporate and Solutions Marketing — translating strategy into activated, multi\-channel programs.
* Drive the campaign calendar, production timelines, and cross\-functional coordination across Growth Marketing, SDR, and Sales.
* Lead pipeline acceleration programs — ABM plays, nurture sequences, and SDR\-aligned follow\-up strategies — that move opportunities through the funnel.
* Identify the highest\-performing campaign motions, build the case to scale them, and present recommendations to the VP for approval.

 **Marketing Automation, Data \& Technology:**

* Own the global marketing automation platform as a revenue system — not a broadcast tool — ensuring it operates with precision, segmentation, and measurable impact.
* Drive lead scoring, routing logic, nurture architecture, and CRM data quality in close collaboration with Revenue Operations.
* Implement the first\-party data strategy set by the VP — enabling signal\-based, personalized marketing at scale.
* Evaluate and recommend AI\-powered marketing tools that improve targeting accuracy, content relevance, and campaign efficiency.

 **Performance Reporting \& Revenue Visibility:**

* Own marketing's performance narrative — pipeline attribution, campaign ROI, funnel conversion, and lifecycle metrics — reported to the VP and broader leadership on a regular cadence.
* Build the dashboards and data infrastructure that give leadership real\-time visibility into marketing's contribution to revenue.
* Drive a culture of measurement, rapid experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making across the team.

 **Partner \& Co\-Marketing Programs:**

* Lead Autodesk MDF/MDP co\-marketing strategy and execution — moving from compliance reporting to strategic pipeline generation.
* Develop co\-marketing campaigns that integrate with the broader campaign calendar and are measured against pipeline contribution.

 **Team Leadership \& Organizational Development:**

* Lead, develop, and elevate a team of five — setting high standards for execution quality, accountability, and strategic contribution.
* Build a team culture where feedback loops are fast, testing is the norm, and performance is visible and celebrated.
* Develop each team member's capability over time, moving the team from executors to strategic contributors.

 **The Team:**

  

You will lead five direct reports spanning automation, content, program operations, and campaign execution:

* **Campaign Marketing Manager** — Global campaign execution, Italian market, Autodesk MDF/MDP co\-marketing.
* **Marketing Automation Manager** — Global automation platform, nurture architecture, lead scoring and routing.
* **Content Specialist** — Blog publishing, web content, editorial calendar execution.
* **Marketing Programs Manager** — Campaign operations, project management, product line and regional activation.
* **Email Execution Specialist** — Campaign build and deployment, platform operations, list management.

  

This is an execution\-strong team with room to grow strategically. Your job is to raise the ceiling.

 **Key Partners:**

* **Corporate Marketing** — Campaign strategy, core content, brand direction
* **Solutions Marketing** — Product positioning, messaging, GTM strategy
* **Digital Marketing** — SEO/GEO, paid media, analytics, web performance
* **Events \& Community** — Regional events, community programs, field activation
* **SDR Practice** — Lead qualification, pipeline acceleration, outbound plays
* **Sales** — Pipeline alignment, deal acceleration, win/loss insight
* **Revenue Operations** — Attribution, data governance, pipeline definitions, reporting

 **Business Purpose \& Value Contribution:**

  

Graitec is at an inflection point. In the last four years we doubled in size. In the next few years, we intend to do it again — this time driven by our own software, not just the products we resell. This Director role sits at the center of that ambition: if marketing gets this right, pipeline becomes predictable, sales cycles shorten, and the brand shifts in the market.

  

The role converts marketing strategy into revenue outcomes. It is accountable for the infrastructure — programs, automation, data, and reporting — that makes marketing's contribution to pipeline visible, repeatable, and scalable across all 13 countries.

  

You will work in a flat, entrepreneurial environment where leaders have real ownership — not a committee for every decision. You will have access to a team ready to grow, a VP who thinks strategically and removes obstacles, and a transformation story that is genuinely compelling in the market.

 **Key Outcomes Expected:**

  

Performance is reviewed quarterly against pipeline and revenue contribution, campaign effectiveness, and the team's progression toward an always\-on operating model. Annual targets are set in partnership with the VP, Global Growth Marketing and Revenue Operations.

 **Pipeline \& Revenue:**

* Marketing\-sourced pipeline ($ and %)
* Marketing\-influenced pipeline
* MQL to SQL to Opportunity conversion rates
* Pipeline velocity

 **Campaign Performance:**

* Pipeline generated per campaign
* Campaign ROI and cost per opportunity
* Engagement rates by channel
* Channel efficiency benchmarks

 **Lifecycle \& Retention:**

* Nurture\-to\-opportunity rate
* Time\-to\-conversion by stage
* Lead recycling effectiveness
* Churn influence via retention plays

 **Operational Excellence:**

* Campaign launch consistency
* Attribution model accuracy
* Automation platform adoption
* Data quality and database health

 **What Success looks like at 12 Months:**

* The team is running always\-on programs — key lifecycle and demand programs are live, being optimized continuously, and not rebuilt from scratch each quarter.
* Marketing has a clear, trusted pipeline attribution model — leadership and Sales agree on the numbers, and they are reported in real time.
* The Campaign Execution team is viewed as a strategic pipeline partner by Sales and SDR — not a service function that produces assets.
* AI tools are embedded in how the team works — accelerating personalization, content, testing, and reporting.
* Each team member has a clear development path and is operating at or above the expectations set for their role.
* Autodesk co\-marketing is generating measurable pipeline contribution, not just MDF compliance.


Responsibilities:
* 8–12 years in B2B marketing, with a majority of that time in demand generation, growth marketing, or campaign execution leadership.
* Demonstrated experience building always\-on marketing programs — lifecycle nurture, ABM, automated demand gen — that were measured against pipeline, not activity.
* Hands\-on proficiency with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot strongly preferred) and CRM systems (Salesforce).
* Proven change management experience — you have led a team or function through a meaningful operational transformation, not just inherited a working model.
* Experience working in B2B SaaS or subscription software — you understand recurring revenue, expansion motion, and the full customer lifecycle.
* AI fluency — you use AI tools actively in your marketing practice and have a point of view on how they change what's possible for a team like this.
* Strong data and analytics capability — you can build attribution models, interpret funnel data, and communicate revenue impact to senior stakeholders.
* Track record of global or multi\-region marketing leadership.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

 **Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in AEC, construction tech, engineering software, or a technical B2B vertical with long sales cycles.
* Familiarity with Autodesk partner co\-marketing programs (MDF/MDP).
* Revenue Operations alignment experience — working alongside RevOps on shared pipeline definitions, data governance, and reporting.
* Experience with intent data platforms, CDPs, or signal\-based marketing orchestration.

 **How You Lead:**

* You are a builder, not a maintainer — you see the gap between where things are and where they should be, and you close it.
* You lead with data and communicate with executive clarity — metrics tell you what to do, but you decide how to frame it for the room.
* You raise the floor on execution quality while raising the ceiling on strategic ambition.
* You operate at the intersection of strategy and operations without losing altitude on either end.
* You build trust quickly with peers in Sales, SDR, Solutions Marketing, and Corporate Marketing — you influence without authority as often as you direct.

title: Principal, Regulatory Science and Strategy - Real World Solutions
description:
Madrid, Spain \| Full time \| Home\-based \| R1560548  
IQVIA is focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding career in Life Sciences Consulting, with opportunities to address diverse and challenging client problems, contribute to cross\-geography engagements, interact with senior client leaders, and gain exposure to a multicultural and collaborative work environment.  


About our team – Regulatory Science and Strategy (RSS)  


The Regulatory Science and Strategy (RSS) group sits within IQVIA's Real World Solutions business and supports life sciences clients in using real world evidence (RWE) more widely and effectively for regulatory purposes. RSS sells and delivers as a unified team, partnering with clients on regulatory strategy, study design, and submission planning across drugs, biologics, and devices. Our work spans externally controlled trials, post\-marketing requirements (PMRs/PMCs), post\-authorization safety studies (PASS), drug utilization studies (DUS), and emerging regulatory technology.  


We are strategic thinkers, deep subject matter experts, and creative at our core. We are collaborative, intellectually curious, and entrepreneurial.  


About the role:  


As a Principal (Director\-level) within RSS, you will own delivery leadership, drive business development, and serve as a subject matter expert across two connected areas: selling and delivering standalone regulatory strategy engagements and cross\-functional RWE studies for regulatory decision\-making. Your work will focus primarily on several areas:  


First, a Principal is expected to lead high\-quality standalone regulatory strategy engagements, build trusted relationships with new and existing clients, and strengthen IQVIA's regulatory science and strategy capabilities.  


Second, the Principal acts as a subject matter expert on the use of RWE across the regulatory lifecycle, partnering cross\-functionally with IQVIA Real World Solutions teams to shape, sell, and deliver RWE studies from pre\-submission strategy through approval and post\-market commitments. An in\-depth understanding of EMA expectations is essential, with the ability to translate those expectations into study designs and submission strategies that clients can act on.  


Specifically, as a member of the RSS team, the Principal participates in regulatory strategy proposal development, advises on regulatory pathways, and supports cross\-functional proposal strategy and delivery for externally controlled trials, PASS, DUS, RegTech advisory work, and broader RWE\-for\-regulatory engagements.  


In addition we expect you to make a key Team and operational contributions to RSS, including mentorship and capability building amongst your junior colleagues  


Responsibilities  


Lead sell and delivery of standalone RSS regulatory strategy engagements, owning workstreams end\-to\-end and supporting team members on complex programs.  


Support cross\-functional IQVIA Real World Solutions teams in selling and delivering RWE generation programs for regulatory audiences, including externally controlled trials, premarket uses of RWE, PASS, and PMR/PMC fulfilment.  


Contribute to RSS regulatory intelligence activities, monitoring the external regulatory environment and surfacing emerging information relevant to IQVIA's offerings and clients.  


Act as a day\-to\-day owner of the regulatory science element of client engagements, with responsibility for client satisfaction and delivery quality.  


Advise on strategy and delivery plans for RSS services, with a focus on EMA RWE activities and lifecycle management, supported by working knowledge of FDA, MHRA, Health Canada, and PMDA.  


Maintain working familiarity with the activities and outputs of EMA and their impact on global harmonization of RW efforts.  


Identify follow\-on work and new revenue opportunities with existing clients, and support business development efforts with new client organizations.  


Collaborate across IQVIA when client requirements span regulatory affairs, clinical development, and real world insights.  


Provide direction, advice, and intellectual leadership to delivery teams and clients.  


Contribute high\-level input to client reports and presentations, and deliver findings to clients directly.  


Mentor and coach junior consultants, sharing subject matter expertise to build RSS capability.  


Participate in annual performance review processes and in recruitment of new staff.  


Skills and Experience  


The successful candidate will have a track record of success across most of the following competencies:  


Industry and regulatory expertise: Maintains a constant focus on regulators, industry, and client trends in life sciences. Applies this knowledge to active client engagements and to business development.  


Real world data expertise: Ability to advise on the design of real world studies to meet regulatory requirements, including externally controlled trials, PASS, PMR fulfillment, etc.  


Regulated medical product experience: Ability to speak with senior client stakeholders about EMA requirements, guidance, and expectations, with working knowledge of FDA, MHRA, Health Canada, and PMDA.  


Client relationship management and delivery: Day\-to\-day owner of client engagements, focused on client satisfaction and outstanding deliverables, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel.  


Business development: Active contributor to proposal development and pre\-sales meetings for standalone regulatory strategy opportunities and cross\-functional RWE study opportunities with new and existing client organizations.  


Solution selling: Ability to identify client pain points and shape custom solutions for life sciences clients.  


Communication and executive presence: Expresses ideas clearly and concisely, and tailors messaging to the audience.  


Cooperative teamwork: Builds supportive relationships within RSS and across IQVIA, based on trust and respect.  


Management of others: Sets clear direction and develops junior team members by delegating appropriately and creating stretch opportunities.  


Coping with decision\-making, customer focus, flexibility, influencing, initiative, innovation, planning and organizing, strategic vision, and technological orientation.  


Qualifications and Other Requirements  


A strong academic track record in a life science\-related discipline or professional equivalent. A relevant graduate degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, MPH, or MS) is preferred.  


At least 7 years of professional experience, with a meaningful portion focused on regulatory science, regulatory strategy, or product review. Prior experience at EMA or another health authority is highly valued.  


Previous experience in life sciences consulting or professional services is preferred.  


Evidence of consistent career progression.  


A track record of project leadership and people development.  


Willingness and ability to travel to client locations.  


Fluency in English (spoken and written).  


Right to live and work in the recruiting country.  


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com  


IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.  


Where you'll work  
Home\-based  


You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.  
Culture  


Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: Senior Direct Response Funnel Copywriter & Strategist
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are looking for an exceptional senior direct response copywriter to take ownership of our post\-click funnels. This is not a role for someone who receives a brief, writes the copy and moves on. We are looking for someone who treats funnels the way an exceptional creative strategist treats advertising: research the customer and the market, form a hypothesis, develop the concept, write the copy, get the funnel launched, study the performance, identify the constraint, develop the next test, and turn every result into a feedback loop.


You will be deeply involved in the commercial performance of everything you write. Once a funnel goes live you should be watching click\-through rates, advertorial to sales page click\-through, quiz completion, sales page and checkout conversion, revenue per visitor, average order value, order bump and upsell take rates, refund rates and contribution margin. A page is not finished when the copy is approved. It is finished when it has launched, been measured, and produced a learning that improves the next page.


Your ultimate objective is to remove the founders from writing and reviewing routine funnel copy. Initially they will remain closely involved and may still write a large share of it. You will work directly with them, learn their frameworks, understand their decision\-making, and gradually take ownership of the function. Success means reaching the point where the founders no longer need to write funnel copy, rewrite your work, or independently double\-check it before launch. From there you create leverage through AI systems, documented processes and, in time, additional writers trained and managed beneath you.


A Note on the Category


This is claims\-led direct response, not product\-led ecommerce, and the distinction matters more than any other line in this description. Our products address chronic pain and mobility. The benefit is not visually obvious, it cannot be demonstrated in a photograph, and it cannot be sold on aspiration. Belief has to be built through mechanism, proof, advertorial and presell structure, and honest handling of objections, all inside the compliance limits of a health category.


Copywriters who have scaled fashion, accessories, beauty or other visually self\-evident products often find that their playbook does not transfer. A strong track record in a product\-led category is welcome but does not substitute for this. We will prioritize candidates who have written for health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category and who understand what can and cannot be said.


Why This Role Is Different


The founders have generated more than nine figures in post\-purchase upsell revenue in under twenty\-four months. That figure is post\-purchase upsell revenue specifically, not total front\-end company revenue. You will get direct access to the frameworks behind those results, existing research, templates, processes and funnel data, direct feedback and training from the founders, a portfolio of brands and offers with significant traffic, a high\-volume testing environment where your ideas get launched and measured, and real commercial data across multiple funnel types, offers and traffic sources.


This is an opportunity to develop beyond being a copywriter. The right person can progress toward Head of Funnel Copy, Head of Funnel Strategy, Director of Conversion, or operator of one of our portfolio brands. We prefer to promote from within, and progression is based on commercial results, leadership ability and the amount of responsibility you can absorb.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


Post\-Click Funnel Strategy


Act as the strategic owner of post\-click messaging and conversion copy. Participate in marketing, campaign and offer planning, understand what each traffic source needs after the click, and ensure message continuity between the advertisement, presell page, sales page, checkout and upsell journey. Recommend the right funnel format based on the offer, traffic source, customer awareness and market sophistication, and determine when a campaign needs an advertorial, listicle, quiz, long\-form page, short\-form page or another structure. Collaborate with media buyers and creative strategists to understand the promise that generated the click, and identify disconnects between the ad message and the landing page experience. Your remit begins at the click, but you must understand the whole acquisition system to make intelligent post\-click decisions.


Customer and Market Research


Research the customer before developing the copy. Analyze reviews, surveys, support tickets, customer interviews, call transcripts, refund reasons and community discussions. Study competitor offers, positioning, mechanisms, pricing and funnel structures. Identify desires, fears, frustrations, failed solutions, objections and buying triggers, understand the customer's level of awareness and the sophistication of the market, and distinguish between what customers say they want and what their behaviour suggests they value. Build voice\-of\-customer libraries that preserve the language customers actually use, validate that claims are supportable and appropriate for the category, and convert raw research into usable copy insight rather than research documents nobody reads.


Hypothesis Before Writing


Every meaningful funnel project begins with a clear hypothesis. Identify the metric or funnel stage being targeted, diagnose the likely reason for underperformance, state the customer insight behind the diagnosis, define what will change and why it should influence behaviour, select a primary success metric and the guardrails around it, and determine what result would validate or invalidate the idea. The first question is not what copy should I write. It is what is the constraint, why does it exist, and what evidence suggests this is the right solution.


Writing Complete Funnels


Write and optimize new offer positioning, unique mechanisms, big ideas, hooks and leads, advertorials, listicles, quiz flows, long\-form and short\-form sales pages, product detail pages, offer sections, pricing and bundle presentation, guarantees, checkout copy, order bumps, post\-purchase upsells, downsells, cross\-sells, funnel transitions, calls to action, and the supporting briefs for page graphics and visual proof. You must be able to develop a major long\-form funnel from a blank page and equally to identify and rewrite the one critical section inside an existing funnel.


The Offer, Not Only the Words


Copy cannot be separated from the offer. You will think critically about positioning, price, quantity, bundles, discounts, bonuses, guarantees, payment options, shipping thresholds, subscription structures, order bumps, upsell sequencing and offer continuity through the funnel. You should be willing to conclude that the copy is not the main problem and that the right recommendation is to change the offer, reorder the upsells, change the price, improve the guarantee, remove a step or target a different segment. Your responsibility is to improve the commercial result, not to defend the original brief.


Funnel Economics


Understand the underlying economics of each offer, including selling price, cost of goods, pick and pack, shipping, payment processing, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, subscription take rates, upsell margins, gross and contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, and revenue and profit per visitor. A higher AOV is not automatically better if contribution margin falls, a higher conversion rate is not better if refunds rise, and a pricing test must be judged on full funnel economics rather than one isolated metric. You do not need to be a finance professional. You do need to think like an owner.


Staying Close to Live Performance


Once your copy is launched, confirm the correct version went live, review performance against the control and at each funnel step, segment where appropriate, compare mobile and desktop, look for discrepancies between traffic sources, use heatmaps and behavioural data where helpful, and compare primary against guardrail metrics. Document what worked, what did not and why, recommend the next action, and feed every meaningful learning back into research and writing. You should feel personal ownership of the result without becoming defensive when an idea loses. A losing test that produces a real learning is useful. A test launched without a hypothesis and never reviewed is not.


The Learning System and AI Leverage


Build and maintain a searchable archive of tests and results recording the original problem, hypothesis, change, result and learning. Identify recurring patterns across brands and funnel types, separate genuine principles from conclusions drawn on insufficient data, convert repeated winners into reusable frameworks, and prevent failed concepts from being unknowingly repeated. Insight should become company knowledge rather than living in one person's head.


Alongside that, become highly AI\-enabled. Use and improve AI\-assisted systems for research synthesis, voice\-of\-customer clustering, transcript and review analysis, competitor and mechanism research, angle development, hypothesis generation, copy outlining, first drafts, variations, objection identification, quality control, claim consistency review, funnel analysis and test documentation. You will not use a generic chatbot to produce first drafts. You will help build structured processes containing the right context, approved source material, brand knowledge, customer research, historical winners, founder frameworks, defined quality criteria and clear review stages. The standard is not whether AI was used. It is whether AI helped us produce better research, better copy, more tests and faster learning without lowering quality.


What We Are Looking For


Substantial professional experience in direct response copywriting, gained over several years writing for real offers with meaningful traffic. A portfolio containing both long\-form and short\-form funnel copy, significant experience writing for cold traffic, and proven experience in DTC ecommerce, direct response or another measurable\-response environment. Evidence that your work has generated meaningful revenue or measurable conversion improvement. Experience writing complete funnels rather than isolated page sections, including advertorials, listicles, sales pages, quizzes, checkouts and post\-purchase upsells.


Experience in health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category, and an understanding of how to build belief where the benefit is not visually demonstrable. A strong grasp of customer awareness, market sophistication, offers, mechanisms, leads, proof, objections and risk reversal. The ability to conduct and synthesize deep customer research and turn it into a clear hypothesis and a persuasive argument.


Strong analytical fluency and comfort with funnel performance data, the ability to diagnose where a funnel is losing customers, a working understanding of AOV, revenue per visitor, upsell take rates, gross margin and contribution margin, experience creating and evaluating conversion tests, and the ability to distinguish correlation, noise and meaningful evidence.


Strong AI fluency with evidence of using AI inside a real research, writing or analysis workflow. The ability to write quickly without sacrificing strategic depth, the confidence to challenge a weak brief or assumption, the humility to change direction when the data disproves an idea, the communication skills to work with founders, media buyers, designers and analysts, and the potential to train and lead additional writers as the function grows. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


High\-volume Meta, native, Google or affiliate traffic, post\-purchase upsell funnels, portfolio or multi\-brand environments, CRO or direct response agencies, subscription offers, and experience building copy systems or training programs are all highly advantageous.


Evidence We Expect to See


Applicants should demonstrate results, not simply submit polished writing samples. Strong evidence includes funnel revenue, conversion rate improvements, revenue per visitor and AOV improvements, upsell take rate and contribution margin improvements, results against an established control, evidence of scaling an offer, before and after funnel performance, and a sequence of tests showing how an insight developed over time.


We understand that candidates may be under confidentiality agreements. Results can be anonymized, but you should still be able to explain what the offer was, what the original problem was, what you personally owned, what research you conducted, what hypothesis you formed, what you changed, which metric moved, how much traffic supported the conclusion, and what happened next. We are more interested in clear thinking and honest attribution than impressive numbers without context.


This Role Is Not


This is not a junior copywriting position, a brand copy role, a content or social media role, or an ad\-copy\-only position. It is not a role where you write from a brief without questioning it, where your responsibility ends when the document is submitted, or where you would rather your work was not measured. It is not a pure CRO analyst role in which you never write, nor a management\-only role in which you no longer produce. It is not for someone who uses AI to generate generic copy and calls that leverage, who needs the founders to supply every angle and mechanism, who waits to be told which test to run, or who blames media buying, design or development without investigating the full funnel.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

title: Head of Web Production (DTC Growth Technology)
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are a direct\-to\-consumer business where technology is a direct function of marketing. Our marketing team can develop a campaign idea and write the copy for it in a single day, but that idea only starts producing revenue once it has become a live, accurate and fully functioning landing page, checkout or funnel. The speed of our production function therefore sets the speed of the entire business.


We are hiring a Head of Web Production to build and own the operating system through which marketing requirements become live digital experiences. Your responsibility is not to manage tasks, chase deadlines or add project management meetings. It is to redesign how the work gets done. You will examine every stage of production, remove unnecessary handoffs, improve requirements, manage dependencies, install effective quality controls, and decide where AI, automation, page builders, reusable components or traditional development should be used.


For every requirement you should be asking whether this genuinely needs a developer, whether it can be built from an existing component or template, whether an AI\-enabled page builder can complete most of it, whether the marketing team can safely complete it without engineering, whether the requirement can be eliminated or standardized, whether the quality check can be automated, and why it is taking as long as it is. Your job is to protect the business objective while continuously challenging the method used to achieve it.


To be explicit about scope, this is not a cloud infrastructure or site reliability role. This is web production and development operations for a high\-volume direct response marketing business.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


The Production Operating System


Map and redesign the workflow from marketing request to production launch, identifying bottlenecks, unnecessary handoffs, waiting time and duplicated work, and establishing clear ownership at every stage. Define what information must exist before work can begin, create work\-in\-progress limits and prioritization rules, and build separate production lanes for urgent changes, standard pages, experiments and complex technical projects so that urgent work stops destroying the predictability of planned work. Create clear escalation paths for blockers and for requirements that change mid\-build.


Requirements and Task Definition


Build standardized briefs for landing pages, checkouts, funnels, upsells and technical changes, and establish a Definition of Ready for every category of work so that incomplete or ambiguous requests never enter development. Ensure every requirement carries complete copy, design direction, references, responsive behaviour, tracking requirements and acceptance criteria, and translate marketing intent into specifications that developers and page builders can execute without repeated clarification. Create a controlled process for requirements that change after development has begun.


AI\-First Production


Audit the full production process for opportunities to use AI and automation, evaluate AI coding tools, AI page builders, no\-code platforms, reusable components and template\-based systems, and determine the right balance between developers, page builders, designers and AI\-enabled operators. Build workflows where AI converts approved briefs, copy and designs into high\-quality first drafts, install guardrails that allow non\-developers to build safely without damaging performance, tracking or brand standards, and reduce repetitive development through reusable sections and approved design systems. Measure the actual impact of AI on cycle time, cost, quality and throughput rather than assuming it.


Dependencies and Capacity


Create visibility over the workload and capacity of development, design and other shared resources, identify dependencies before work enters production, and sequence work based on when copy, graphics, video, development and approvals will realistically be available. Prevent developers from being assigned work that cannot be completed because a dependency is missing, build a capacity planning system that lets marketing understand what can actually be delivered and when, and surface constraints early enough for the business to reprioritize or find an alternative. Reduce reliance on informal messages and on individual managers holding critical information in their heads.


Quality Built Into the Process


Move quality control upstream instead of relying on final\-stage inspection. Introduce developer self\-QC before any task is submitted, create standardized QC checklists by page and funnel type, define acceptance criteria before development begins, and establish an independent final QC process that does not depend entirely on one person. Implement automated testing wherever practical, including visual regression, broken links, responsive layouts, tracking, checkout functionality, browser compatibility and page performance. Categorize defects, track root causes, and ensure repeated defects change the underlying system, checklist, component or training rather than being corrected one at a time.


Team Structure and Capability


Lead the existing production team and raise its operating standard. Determine which work should be completed by developers and which should be completed by AI\-enabled production specialists, and make sure capability is matched to the work. Coach the team on estimation, task clarification, self\-QC and AI\-assisted workflows, set clear performance expectations for speed, predictability and quality, and build enough documentation and shared visibility that the function does not depend on any single person holding critical context.


The Measurement System


Build and maintain reporting on request\-to\-launch cycle time, active production time versus waiting time, throughput by work category, on\-time delivery, clarification interactions after assignment, first\-pass QC rate, average revision rounds, escaped defect rate, rework hours, blocker age, the share of work completed through reusable components or AI\-assisted workflows, cost per page or funnel, and marketing launch delays caused by technology or creative dependencies. These metrics exist to improve the system, not to generate reporting.


How Success Will Be Measured


Your first thirty days are about establishing a baseline. We do not currently measure cycle time, waiting time, clarification loops, rework or escaped defects, so your first task is to map the current state from request to launch and put real numbers against it, then produce a prioritized roadmap for improving the system. We would rather agree ambitious targets against real data than hand you numbers invented before anyone measured anything.


By sixty days we expect a standardized intake and requirements process, clear Definitions of Ready and Done, service\-level expectations by category of work, visibility over development and creative capacity, dependency planning across copy, design, video, development, tracking and approvals, piloted AI\-assisted and template\-driven workflows, and a live operating dashboard covering speed, quality and throughput.


By ninety days we expect the function to be trending strongly toward a materially shorter median request\-to\-launch cycle time, the large majority of work delivered by the committed date, the large majority of work passing final QC without another development round, a sharp reduction in issues identified after approval by the CEO or the media buyer, full visibility over active work, dependencies, blockers and capacity, standard page types produced without bespoke development, and higher throughput without a corresponding increase in headcount. Exact targets will be finalized against your baseline.  

  

What We Are Looking For


Significant experience improving the operations of a web development, digital production or growth technology team, with a proven record of reducing delivery time, increasing throughput or improving first\-pass quality. Experience in an environment where development speed directly affects revenue. A strong working understanding of landing pages, ecommerce funnels, checkouts, upsells, testing and conversion\-focused web production.


Enough technical depth to challenge estimates, architecture choices and development approaches, including a working understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, analytics, tracking, page builders and modern web development workflows. Experience implementing AI tools or automation inside a real production environment rather than as a pilot or a talking point. Experience designing intake processes, acceptance criteria, capacity planning and quality control systems, and a strong grasp of dependencies and constraint management.


The ability to communicate effectively with marketers, copywriters, designers, media buyers and developers, and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when a requirement is unclear, unnecessarily complicated or being solved in the wrong way. Strong analytical ability, comfort making decisions from operational data, and a bias toward simplification, standardization and measurable results.


Experience with direct response ecommerce, high\-volume web production, Shopify, Checkout Champ, Figma, landing page builders, CRO testing and marketing analytics is highly advantageous. Formal qualifications are not required where there is strong evidence of relevant outcomes. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


This Role Is Not


This is not a traditional cloud\-infrastructure DevOps role, a Jira administration role, a project coordinator position, or a role focused on running agile ceremonies. It is not a role for someone who accepts every requirement without questioning it, whose first answer to any constraint is additional headcount, who can describe AI tools but has never embedded them into an operational workflow, or who wants engineering leadership disconnected from marketing and revenue.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.
