title: Nômade Temple Madrid - F&B Director
description:
**About Nômade Temple Madrid**


Nômade Temple Madrid is more than a space, it is a vibrant hub where community, creativity, and conscious living meet in the heart of the city. Inspired by the bohemian and soulful essence of the Nômade universe, we bring together gastronomy, culture, wellness, and lifestyle to create meaningful and elevated experiences.

**Your role**


As **F\&B Director**, you will be responsible for leading the overall Food \& Beverage strategy and operation at Nômade Temple Madrid, overseeing our restaurants, bars, events, and F\&B experiences while ensuring that each outlet reflects the Nômade philosophy and achieves the highest standards of guest experience, operational excellence, team engagement, and financial performance. Working closely with the General Manager and the leadership team, you will drive the commercial and operational performance of the department, identify new opportunities, develop innovative concepts, optimize revenue and profitability, and lead a high\-performing team that delivers authentic, memorable, and distinctive hospitality experiences.

**What you will do**

* Define and lead the overall Food \& Beverage strategy for Nômade Temple Madrid, aligned with the brand vision and business objectives.
* Oversee the daily operation and performance of all F\&B outlets, ensuring consistency in service, quality, presentation, and guest experience.
* Develop and implement annual F\&B budgets, business plans, revenue strategies, and operational objectives.
* Drive profitability through effective management of revenue, food cost, beverage cost, labor cost, productivity, and operational expenses.
* Monitor key F\&B performance indicators and develop action plans to maximize revenue and profitability.
* Lead the development and continuous evolution of our restaurant, bar, rooftop, event, and other F\&B concepts.
* Ensure that each outlet has a clear identity while maintaining a consistent Nômade approach to hospitality.
* Collaborate closely with the Executive Chef and culinary leadership to develop menus, concepts, pricing strategies, and gastronomic experiences.
* Work together with Marketing, Events, Wellness, Sales, and Operations teams to create innovative experiences and activations that connect with our guests and community.
* Build strong relationships with suppliers, partners, producers, and external collaborators.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding, training, development, and succession planning across the F\&B department.
* Inspire and develop F\&B leaders, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and maintain service standards, operational procedures, and quality benchmarks across all F\&B areas.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, health \& safety, licensing, and company standards.
* Analyze guest feedback, market trends, and industry developments to continuously improve the F\&B offering.
* Identify new commercial opportunities and partnerships that can increase revenue and strengthen the positioning of Nômade Temple Madrid.
* Represent the F\&B department within the hotel's leadership team and act as an ambassador of the Nômade brand.
* Contribute to the long\-term positioning and growth of Nômade Temple Madrid as a distinctive hospitality and lifestyle destination in Madrid.

**Who we’re looking for**

* An inspiring and commercially minded F\&B leader with a genuine passion for hospitality, gastronomy, and guest experience.
* A strategic thinker who can translate a brand vision into successful and profitable F\&B operations.
* A natural leader capable of inspiring, developing, and empowering diverse teams.
* Strong business acumen and a clear understanding of F\&B financial performance.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* A creative and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and turn ideas into experiences.
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to maintain a clear strategic perspective.
* A hands\-on leader who understands that exceptional hospitality is created through both people and operational excellence.
* Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable working in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.

**Requirements**

* Extensive experience in a senior Food \& Beverage leadership position, preferably as F\&B Director, F\&B Manager, or equivalent within luxury hotels, lifestyle hospitality, high\-end restaurants, or multi\-outlet operations.
* Proven experience managing multiple F\&B outlets and complex hospitality operations.
* Strong knowledge of F\&B financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and revenue optimization.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing F\&B concepts and commercial strategies.
* Proven track record of leading, developing, and retaining high\-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of luxury hospitality service standards and guest experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, health \& safety, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills.
* Fluency in Spanish and English.
* Additional languages are a plus.
* Valid EU / Spain work permit.

**Why join us?**


Because at Nômade, hospitality is not just operations, it is emotion, precision, and experience. You will be part of a vibrant environment where people, culture, and creativity come together to create unforgettable moments.

***Equal Opportunity Commitment***

*At Nômade Temple, we are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and respectful environment for all. We ensure equal opportunities in our recruitment process and guarantee fair treatment regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. All hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and alignment with our values.*

description:
Job Description:
**Global Marketing Associate**


 AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  

Warsaw, Poland or Madrid, Spain.


At AXA XL, we build and protect our market profile and brand by proactively shaping and executing an integrated global marketing programme, in close alignment with our Chief Client Office and regional business unit strategies. The Global Marketing Associate will help to achieve AXA XL’s global marketing goals by contributing to increased market visibility for our products and services, including thought leadership, amongst clients, brokers and the industries we serve.


As a Global Marketing Associate, you will support the Global Marketing Director and wider team in developing, coordinating and delivering marketing activity for AXA XL’s key growth areas: Future of Energy, Data Centers and Multinational Solutions. The role will also support wider Chief Client Office marketing programmes, including global events, sponsorships, client engagement campaigns and digital marketing activation across account\-based marketing, email, webinar and website channels. You will also work closely with regional marketing teams to help provide consistent and up\-to\-date global marketing resources that enhance our market presence.


In this role, you will provide hands\-on marketing support across planning, campaign delivery, content development, stakeholder coordination and performance reporting. You will work closely with members of the global marketing team and with internal and outsourced resources, while contributing to global internal and external Communications, Brand and Marketing projects and Chief Client Office initiatives.


**What****you’ll be doing**
---------------------------


What will your essential responsibilities include?


* Supporting the Global Marketing Director and business stakeholders in developing global marketing resources that support retention, new business and brand positioning across strategic growth areas including Future of Energy, Data Centers and Multinational Solutions.
* Assisting with the delivery of integrated marketing campaigns using the full suite of marketing tools and channels, such as digital advertising, account\-based marketing, email campaigns, webinar programmes, collateral material, web content, events and sponsorships.
* Supporting marketing plans for key growth initiatives, including Future of Energy, Data Centers and Multinational Solutions.
* Providing coordination and execution support for global events, sponsorships and client engagement programmes, including planning, stakeholder management, content development, logistics support and post\-event reporting.
* Contributing to marketing activity that supports Chief Client Office priorities, including client growth, broker engagement, strategic account development and global campaign activation.
* Supporting regional Distribution and marketing teams with up\-to\-date global marketing resources, campaign materials and messaging guidance.
* Collaborating with regional marketing teams and the Global Brand team to help ensure consistent marketing materials are used and best practices are shared.
* Working with the Digital Marketing team to maintain and update website content for priority growth areas and support the execution of global digital marketing campaigns, including account\-based marketing, email marketing, webinar programmes, paid digital activity and website updates.
* Supporting performance reporting across campaigns, events, sponsorships and digital channels, including engagement metrics, lead generation, pipeline influence and return on investment where available.
* Supporting CRM discipline and campaign tracking by helping ensure relevant marketing activity, client engagement and follow\-up actions are captured accurately in CRM systems.
* Drafting, editing and coordinating copy for collateral material, web content, presentations and campaign assets, working with internal teams and outsourced agencies as needed.
* Using data\-driven insights and analytical tools to monitor campaign performance, compile reports and support recommendations for optimization.
* Helping ensure timely execution of projects by coordinating with internal Brand \& Design, Media/PR, Digital and other relevant teams.
* Representing the Global Marketing function in selected internal business meetings and supporting preparation for external industry events.
* Supporting relationships with external marketing agencies and helping manage project timelines, deliverables and budgets.
* Building effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, including Sales, Product, Distribution and Executive teams.


You will report to the Global Marketing Director.**What****you’ll bring**
------------------------

We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:


* Experience in commercial and/or B2B marketing, with the ability to support planning, coordination and delivery across multiple projects simultaneously.
* A collaborative, proactive approach and a passion for helping deliver intelligent, creative work as part of a team, for measurable success.
* Excellent written and oral communication abilities alongside an outstanding attention to detail.
* Proven ability to work independently and in a collaborative, hybrid team\-oriented environment
* Robust organizational skills and the ability to support time\-critical projects through planning, scheduling, monitoring and budget tracking.
* Experience supporting digital marketing activation, including account\-based marketing, email campaigns, webinars, CRM\-supported campaign tracking and website content management.
* A keen ability to execute, deliver results, approach tasks proactively and anticipate needs.
* Eager to learn and focused on continuously improving technical skills.
* Experience in Insurance or Financial Services industry is preferred.
* BA in Marketing or Communications or equivalent.

**What****we****offer**
-----------------------

**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. *It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family\-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

  

Learn more at axaxl.com/about\-us/inclusion\-and\-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. **Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.

title: Regional Marketing Manager - Europe
description:
**About Camlin**
Camlin is a global technology leader that operates with the vision of bringing revolutionary products to life for a wide range of industries, including power and rail, and also has interests in a number of R\&D projects in a variety of scientific sectors.  

At Camlin we believe in high quality engineering and design, allowing us to develop market leading products and services. In short, we love creating value for our customers by solving difficult problems. As of now, Camlin operates in over 20 countries worldwide. **Regional Marketing Manager, Europe**

**Department:** Marketing  

**Reports To:** Head of Regional Marketing  

**Travel:** Up to 30%

 **Overview**


Camlin Energy is seeking a commercially focused Regional Marketing Manager to lead marketing execution across Europe. This role is responsible for developing and delivering regional marketing plans that create demand, support strategic account growth, strengthen customer relationships and contribute directly to revenue and pipeline objectives.


Working closely with regional sales teams, product specialists and senior stakeholders, the successful candidate will ensure marketing activity is aligned with priority markets, customer needs and commercial growth targets.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Regional Marketing Strategy \& Execution**

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly marketing plans aligned to regional business objectives.
* Translate global marketing strategies into local market activity.
* Drive integrated campaigns across digital, content, events, ABM and customer engagement programmes.
* Ensure regional marketing activity supports revenue growth, pipeline creation and customer retention.
* Develop regional\-specific messaging frameworks to drive a high\-quality output of marketing materials and thought\-leadership content

**Commercial \& Sales Alignment**

* Partner closely with regional sales leadership and account teams.
* Support strategic account growth through targeted customer engagement programmes.
* Develop marketing initiatives that accelerate opportunities through the sales cycle.
* Create customer\-focused assets that support commercial conversations and account progression.

**Demand Generation**

* Deliver campaigns that generate qualified leads and measurable pipeline impact.
* Work with demand generation and digital specialists to optimise performance across channels.
* Monitor campaign effectiveness and implement continuous improvements.

**Events \& Customer Engagement**

* Lead regional event strategy, including industry exhibitions, executive briefings, webinars and customer forums.
* Maximise event ROI through integrated pre\-event, onsite and post\-event campaigns.
* Build opportunities for customer advocacy and thought leadership.

**Market Intelligence**

* Monitor industry trends, regulatory policies, competitive activity and emerging market opportunities.
* Provide regional insights to support marketing and business planning.
* Identify new growth opportunities within transmission, distribution and critical infrastructure sectors.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work collaboratively with product, sales, engineering and corporate marketing teams.
* Build strong relationships with Siemens Energy marketing counterparts and regional stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment between regional execution and global priorities.

 **Requirements**

**Essential**

* 6\+ years' experience in B2B marketing.
* Strong content writing skills, with the ability to turn technical product information into creative copy for a range of formats
* Experience supporting complex technical or industrial products and services.
* Proven track record delivering integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of demand generation and pipeline development.
* Experience working with sales teams and supporting strategic accounts through account\-based marketing activity.
* Experience within energy, utilities, electrical infrastructure, industrial technology or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Excellent project management and organisational skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of European utility and energy markets.
* Experience operating within a matrix or multinational organisation.
* Additional European language skills.

**Success Measures**

* Contribution to regional pipeline and revenue targets.
* Marketing\-sourced and influenced opportunities.
* Strategic account engagement metrics.
* Campaign performance and ROI.
* Lead\-to\-opportunity conversion performance.
* Growth in customer engagement and brand awareness across priority markets.

* We believe in people
* We won’t accept the ‘way it has always been done’
* We listen to learn
* We’re trying to do the right thing

About ContourGlobal
  
  

ContourGlobal, a KKR company, is an established Independent Power Producer (IPP) focused on developing, acquiring, and operating electricity generation and storage assets across Europe, North and South America, with a presence in Africa and Asia. The company currently manages 5\.5 GW of installed capacity across multiple technologies and asset classes, with an additional 800 MW of renewables under construction and nearly 12\.6 GW under development.
  
  

ContourGlobal is accelerating the decarbonization of its portfolio and evolving into a predominantly renewable IPP, supported by long\- term contracts and innovative PPAs coupled with energy management solutions that deliver value beyond market standards. As a symbol of its ongoing transformation and growth, the company recently unveiled a new brand identity, celebrating 20 years of history and embracing The Right Power Forward as its guiding purpose.
  
  

We are recruiting for PLANT MANAGER based in our Orellana CSP plant in Badajoz.
  
  

The candidate will be the maximum responsible for the long – term strategic planning of both Operations and Maintenance activities of the Plant, prioritizing the safety of people and equipment, in order to achieve the maximum performance and availability of the Plant, also supervising compliance with the financial budget of the project, and planning the strategic plans and responding to any Plant problem in a timely manner and in real time, being the guarantor that all this is carried out in an environment of safety and adequate quality, according to existing standards.
  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

Organize and coordinate resources, prioritize activities and ensure Plant operation in accordance with Dispatch requirements.
  
Evaluate the current performance of the plant assets, ensuring efficiency, equipment effectiveness, safety, environment, as well as a cost evaluation, monitoring and performance reports (including daily, weekly and monthly reports).
  
Develop an operations strategy to ensure that objectives are achieved.
  
Establishment of “best practices” and effective operations processes, with technical expertise that can be nurtured and shared throughout the company.

description:
**The Role:**

Morningstar DBRS is seeking a **Manager, Data Quality \& Controls** to lead the development and execution of the enterprise data quality and controls program. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Products, this role will assess existing controls, identify gaps, and establish standards, processes, and governance to ensure critical ratings, regulatory, and enterprise data is accurate, complete, well\-documented, and fit for purpose.


The Manager will drive the data controls roadmap, design scalable quality controls, and partner across Data Management, Credit Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Product teams to embed strong data practices into operations, regulatory reporting, platform modernization, and AI initiatives.


The ideal candidate has experience building or enhancing data governance and control frameworks within a regulated financial services environment and can influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization.


**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Controls \& Governance**

Lead the design and ongoing enhancement of the enterprise data controls framework, including governance standards, workflows, metrics, issue management, and remediation processes. Assess existing controls, identify gaps, and drive improvements that align with regulatory requirements, audit expectations, and industry best practices. Own the data controls roadmap and promote data stewardship, accountability, and ownership across the organization.


**Standards, Procedures \& Data Quality**

Develop and maintain data governance standards, procedures, and controls related to data quality, metadata, lineage, documentation, classification, retention, and issue management. Implement data quality checks, validations, and monitoring processes to ensure critical datasets remain accurate, complete, and compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements.


**Data Platform \& External Feed Controls**

Partner with business and technology teams to support platform modernization and data\-feed initiatives, ensuring data integrity and control continuity throughout migrations and enhancements. Define control requirements for data products, integrations, APIs, analytics, and AI\-enabled solutions, while establishing quality standards and validating migration outcomes.


**Leadership \& Team Development**

Lead and develop a team of data analysts by providing coaching, setting priorities, and overseeing deliverables. Drive excellence in data quality monitoring, metadata management, issue remediation, and the adoption of data governance best practices and tools.


**AI\-Ready Data Management**

Establish data and metadata standards that support AI, analytics, and automation initiatives. Ensure datasets are properly documented, governed, and controlled, with clear ownership, lineage, and quality measures. Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, Risk, and Technology teams to promote responsible AI practices, data privacy, and transparent use of enterprise data assets.


**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Science, Computer Science, or Management Studies (Master's a plus).

Technical requirements emphasize control execution, data\-quality oversight, and monitoring.


* **Cloud and data platforms:** exposure to modern cloud platforms: Snowflake, Azure, or AWS
* **Data controls and catalog platforms:** experience with metadata, lineage, and catalog tools such as DataHub, Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Microsoft Purview, or equivalents.
* **SQL:** ability to query, analyze, and validate large datasets in MS SQL Server or similar platforms.
* **Data quality and lineage:** data profiling, reconciliation, root\-cause analysis, and end\-to\-end lineage documentation.
* **AI controls:** working understanding of responsible\-AI principles and controls for AI\-ready data.
* **BI and analytics:** experience building governance, data\-quality, control, or operational dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
* **Financial data:** familiarity with fixed income, structured finance, credit ratings, and capital\-markets data; experience with Bloomberg and/or Refinitiv Eikon is a plus.

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain data controls concepts to technical and business audiences.

* Sound judgment, attention to detail, and a structured results\-oriented approach to complex problems.

Hyatt is looking for an Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns \& Projects to join the Digital \& Direct Channel team in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, working under a hybrid model.


In this role, you will contribute to the growth of Hyatt’s direct channels through the planning, execution, and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, as well as the coordination of projects related to the digital and web experience. Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

* Act as a liaison between Digital Marketing, Web, Contact Center, Revenue Management, Operations, eDistribution, and Marketing teams.
* Coordinate digital projects from end to end, managing milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
* Monitor performance, define and track CRM KPIs, and prepare reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

**Who You Are**

  

You are passionate about improving the customer experience through data, technology, and creativity. You are organized, collaborative, and results\-oriented, with the ability to coordinate complex projects and connect teams with different perspectives.

Croatia, Spain or the Netherlands

title: Community & Social Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Percona is looking for someone who can own our technical voice across social and content channels \- someone who reads a MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB changelog for fun, can turn an engineer's Slack message into a post developers actually stop scrolling for, and thinks in terms of a content strategy rather than a content calendar.
   

  

 This role sits inside Engineering, not Marketing. You'll be embedded with the people doing the actual database work, sitting in on the same standups and design discussions, because that's where the content comes from. This isn't an events role, and it isn't a "translate engineering for the business" role either \- it's for someone credible enough to be treated as a peer by engineers, who happens to also own how that work gets told to the world.
   

  

****What You Will Do****
*Social \& Content Strategy (the core of the role)*
* Own the social media strategy end to end: channel priorities, content pillars, voice, cadence, and how success is measured \- not just execution of a plan handed to you.
* Translate real engineering work (patches, RFCs, performance benchmarks, incident postmortems, contributions upstream) into content developers and DBAs actually value. Threads, technical breakdowns, short\-form video, dev.to/blog cross\-posts.
* Build a repeatable system for sourcing content directly from engineering work in flight. Release cycles, RFC discussions, on\-call retros etc. rather than depending on ad hoc asks.
* Use AI\-assisted tools for production (video, drafting, repurposing) without losing technical accuracy or authenticity.
* Define and track the metrics that actually matter for a technical audience (engaged developers, not just impressions) and report on what's working.


*Embedded Technical Credibility*
* Sit close enough to engineering to actually understand what's shipping and why. Attend the relevant standups, sprint reviews, or design discussions as a regular participant, not an occasional observer.
* Be genuinely fluent in open source database engineering conversations. MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB internals, replication, performance tuning, or similar. Enough to interview an engineer, catch a technical inaccuracy, and ask the right follow\-up questions.
* Participate authentically in the communities you're writing for (forums, Slack/Discord, GitHub discussions). This is source material and credibility, not a separate job.
* Push back on engineers' first drafts of an explanation when it's technically sloppy or won't land with the audience, and earn the trust to do that.


*Community Signal, Not Community Ops*
* Monitor community sentiment and conversation on social and community channels to inform what content to make next.
* Amplify contributor and community voices as part of the content strategy.
* Light moderation/engagement on owned channels as needed \- this is in service of content and strategy, not a standalone community\-management function.


 What's Explicitly Out of Scope
   

  

 This role does not own event logistics, on\-site conference representation, swag/booth coordination, or contributor/ambassador program administration. Some occasional travel for content capture (e.g., filming at a conference Percona is already attending) may come up, but travel is not a core expectation.
   

  

****What You Have Done****
* A demonstrated ability to go deep on technical subject matter \- you don't need to ship production code, but you need to understand database/open\-source engineering concepts well enough to write about them accurately, defend that accuracy to an engineer, and be trusted in an engineering room.
* A portfolio or track record of technical content (blog, social, video) aimed at developers or infrastructure/ops audiences.
* Experience owning a social strategy, not just executing one. From channel selection and content planning, to measurement.
* Real, active participation in open source or developer communities.
* Strong short\-form video creation skills, including on\-camera presence.
* Excellent technical writing. Ability to accurately summarize something like a query optimizer change or a replication failure mode for a technical audience.
* Comfortable working directly with engineers as primary sources, day to day, as part of the team rather than a periodic interviewer.


****What Will Make You Stand Out****
* Hands\-on experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB (as a user, DBA, or contributor).
* A history of contributing to open source projects (code, docs, or community).
* Prior experience embedded in or adjacent to an engineering team (DevRel, technical writing, or similar) rather than in a pure marketing/comms function.
* Experience building a technical brand's presence from a smaller base i.e., you've done this from scratch, not just maintained an existing machine.


**Why Percona?**
 At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.
   

  

 Percona is proud to be a remote\-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly\-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.
   

  

 Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work\-from\-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.
   

  

 If you love the idea of working with a high\-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open\-source database space, let’s talk!
   

  

 Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

Arabnb Holiday Homes — Vacation Homes \& Hospitality · Create and execute a social media content calendar for Arabnb across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, showcasing our luxury vacation home portfolio.

· Plan, set up, run, and optimise paid advertising campaigns through Meta Business Suite (Facebook \& Instagram Ads), including audience targeting, A/B testing, budget management, and performance reporting.

· Set up and manage TikTok Ads campaigns when required.

· Design graphics, carousels, thumbnails, and marketing creatives using Canva and other design tools for both brands.

· Manage influencer outreach and coordinate collaborations relevant to either brand.

Ability to read and act on ad performance data is a must.

· Photography skills and comfort being on camera or directing others on camera.

· Familiarity with CRM tools or lead capture workflows.

**What We Offer**

· Opportunity to take full ownership of the social media presence for two growing Dubai brands — in luxury hospitality.

· A dynamic, fast\-paced work environment with room for creativity, ownership, and career growth.

· Updated CV/Resume.

Pay: AED5,000\.00 \- AED6,000\.00 per month

title: Director of ASIC Design
description:
**About Positron AI**
=====================


Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Our first\-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting\-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway.

**Role Overview**
=================


We are looking for a Director of ASIC Design to drive the design, development, verification, and execution of high\-performance AI inference chips. This role requires deep technical expertise in ASIC architecture and low\-power design methodologies, along with a strong understanding of AI/ML workloads. The ideal candidate will bring a proven track record of leading ASIC teams from concept through production in a startup or fast\-paced environment, and will play a central role in shaping the technical direction and execution of Positron's silicon roadmap.
This is a remote position; however, candidates must be based in the Austin, Texas metropolitan area. This location requirement allows for occasional in\-person collaboration, meetings, or team events as needed.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Leadership \& Architecture*** Lead the ASIC development team in the design, verification, and implementation of AI inference hardware.
* Define and specify ASIC architecture, microarchitecture, and roadmap in alignment with company goals and AI workload requirements.
* Optimize power, performance, and area (PPA) trade\-offs to meet stringent AI inference requirements, including memory subsystem optimizations.

**Execution \& Delivery*** Oversee RTL design, physical design, verification, and validation processes across the full chip development lifecycle.
* Drive Customer Owned Tooling (COT) tape\-out and bring\-up activities, ensuring successful first silicon validation and production ramp\-up.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Vendor Management*** Collaborate closely with software and prototyping teams to ensure hardware/software co\-design optimizations.
* Manage relationships with foundries, IP vendors, and EDA tool providers.

**Team Building*** Recruit, mentor, and develop a high\-performing ASIC team.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* A degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in ASIC development, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* A proven track record of delivering multiple ASIC/COT projects from concept to mass production.
* Deep understanding of digital design, verification, physical design, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience with leading AI accelerators, high\-performance computing (HPC), or data center chip designs.
* Strong knowledge of RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), synthesis, and timing closure.
* Expertise in low\-power design techniques and optimizing power for very high\-performance chips.
* Expertise in memory subsystem optimizations.
* Familiarity with EDA tools such as Cadence, Synopsys, and Mentor Graphics.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in AI/ML accelerator design or custom AI silicon.
* A track record of defining and deploying a full EDA methodology based on Cadence or Synopsys tool suites.
* Successful tape\-out experience on 7nm, 5nm, and/or 3nm COT designs.
* Understanding of chiplet\-based architectures and heterogeneous computing.
* Experience integrating external memory and IP modules.
* Knowledge of RISC\-V or custom processor development.
* A track record of successful technology development within a dynamic startup environment.

### **Leveling \& Scope**


While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Be at the forefront of AI inference hardware innovation, with the opportunity to shape the future of AI acceleration technology.
* Work alongside a world\-class team of engineers and AI researchers, with a competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package.

**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------


The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $350,000\.  

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.  

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

**Benefits \& Perks**
---------------------


We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
* Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more
* Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available

**Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off – we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge
* 13 paid company holidays
* Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup

**Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity
* 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one

**Visa Support**
----------------


This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

title: Head of Production, Maternity Cover
description:
Molecular Sound is looking for an experienced Head of Production to join our London team on a fixed\-term maternity cover contract from **12 October 2026 to 1 September 2027**.


We're a specialist music and sound company working across sonic branding, original music and composition, broadcast, sport and sound design. Our work is created for some of the world's biggest brands, including Sky, Disney, Premier League and Guinness, as well as leading branding agencies, broadcasters and advertising agencies.


This is a senior, hands\-on role for someone who can take ownership of production across the business, manage key client relationships and help keep a busy creative studio running smoothly.


### **The role**


You'll be responsible for:


* Managing incoming briefs and client enquiries
* Quoting, budgeting and overseeing project finances
* Scheduling our in\-house composer team and freelance creatives
* Managing production timelines, priorities and deadlines across multiple projects
* Acting as a senior point of contact for clients throughout projects
* Organising recording sessions, studios, musicians and suppliers
* Managing feedback, amends and final deliverables
* Advising on music licensing, usage and rights
* Managing suppliers and our wider freelance creative network
* Overseeing purchase orders, invoicing and project profitability
* Supporting new business opportunities and pitches
* Managing and supporting our three\-person composer team
* Leading internal resourcing and production meetings
* Taking ownership of key accounts and major projects
* Keeping senior leadership informed on pipeline, resourcing, commercial performance and potential risks


You'll report directly to **Dave Connolly, Director**, work closely with him on major projects and pitches, and form part of the company's senior leadership team.


### **About you**


We're looking for someone with **5\+ years' experience** in a senior production role, such as Senior Producer, Executive Producer or Head of Production.


Ideally, you'll have experience within sonic branding, music production, composition, sound design or audio post. However, we're also open to candidates from broader advertising or creative production backgrounds who have strong music knowledge and relevant client experience.


You should be:


* Experienced working with brands, agencies and creative teams
* Confident managing significant budgets and commercial conversations
* Knowledgeable about music licensing, usage and rights
* Familiar with production music, publishing and PRS
* An excellent client communicator
* Calm under pressure and comfortable making decisions
* Extremely organised and capable of managing multiple live projects at once
* Proactive and able to work independently
* Commercially minded, with an eye for opportunities
* A strong people manager
* Diplomatic when navigating feedback or challenging conversations
* Collaborative and comfortable working within a small, hands\-on team
* Interested in music, creativity and culture
* Comfortable using Streamtime or similar project management software
* Ideally connected to a network of composers, musicians, studios and freelance creatives


Technical audio engineering knowledge is not essential.


### **What success looks like**


During the maternity cover period, we'd expect you to:


* Keep production running smoothly across the business
* Maintain and strengthen our client relationships
* Protect project margins and keep budgets under control
* Help convert new business opportunities
* Improve production systems and processes where useful
* Support and develop our composer team
* Strengthen our freelance creative network
* Maintain clear visibility across pipeline, resourcing and risk
* Take confident ownership of important clients and projects


### **The details**


**Role:** Head of Production, Maternity Cover  

**Contract:** Fixed term, 12 October 2026 to 1 September 2027  

**Location:** Shoreditch, London  

**Working pattern:** Full\-time, hybrid, with four days per week in the studio and one remote day  

**Salary:** Negotiable, depending on experience


Benefits include holiday allowance, pension, private healthcare, flexible working, a well\-equipped studio environment and a warm, friendly culture with regular team social events.


This is a maternity cover position and the existing Head of Production will be returning to the role. Depending on business needs and mutual fit, there may also be opportunities to discuss a broader permanent position within Molecular Sound beyond the fixed\-term contract.


### **How to apply**


Please send us your **CV along with examples of relevant projects and clients**, and include:


* Current salary
* Salary expectations
* Notice period
* Confirmation of your right to work in the UK
* Earliest available start date


**Please note: we will only review applications submitted through Breezy HR or LinkedIn. Applications or enquiries sent by email, telephone, direct message or through any other channel will not be considered.**

* **Collaborator**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Proven ability to translate business challenges into human\-first, commercially valuable design

title: Culture Marketing Lead - MENAT+
description:
Spotify is looking for a senior marketing leader to join our MENAT\+ team as Culture Marketing Lead. This is a rare opportunity to define and own the cultural narrative of Spotify across some of the most dynamic and fast\-growing markets in the world, including Türkiye, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 As part of the Marketing team, you'll lead our culture, content, and experiential marketing efforts, building campaigns at the intersection of music, culture, and community to make Spotify the true home for fans. You'll bring deep expertise in the MENA and Türkiye cultural and creative landscape, along with a proven track record of building brands that authentically move with culture.
   

  

 Working closely with our Music team, Global Brand teams, artists, creators, and external partners, you'll deliver marketing that fans genuinely love. This role reports to the Head of Marketing, MENAT\+ and is based in Dubai.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Define and lead Spotify's culture marketing strategy across MENAT\+, developing campaigns that tap into music, pop culture, and youth culture to grow brand love and cultural relevance.
* Lead the development and execution of culturally rooted campaigns spanning content, partnerships, creator collaborations, and experiential marketing.
* Partner closely with Spotify's Music team to develop and execute artist marketing plans and integrated go\-to\-market campaigns, serving as the primary marketing interface for music and artist\-led initiatives across the region.
* Define the region's content pillars and editorial voice, working across short\-form video, long\-form storytelling, social\-first content, editorial features, and emerging formats to create content that earns attention organically.
* Build and manage high\-impact experiential activations, live events, and fan experiences that connect Spotify to local culture in meaningful ways.
* Serve as the cultural authority for the region, championing bold, original ideas while ensuring consistency with Spotify's global brand.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Content Marketing Managers, fostering collaboration, creativity, and high performance.
* Establish measurement frameworks for culture and content marketing, using audience insights and performance data to refine strategy and demonstrate business impact.
* Stay ahead of cultural trends, shifts in consumer behaviour, and the competitive landscape across MENA and Türkiye, bringing fresh perspectives and outside\-in thinking to the team.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have 10\+ years of experience in marketing, with a significant focus on culture, music, content, and experiential marketing, ideally within entertainment, media, or technology platforms.
* You are a content strategist at heart and have built content programmes from the ground up, with a deep understanding of how different formats perform across platforms and a strong editorial instinct for what a brand should and shouldn't say.
* You have extensive experience partnering with music teams, artists, labels, and creative partners, and understand how to balance artist storytelling with brand objectives.
* You have successfully built, led, and developed high\-performing marketing teams.
* You are deeply immersed in music and culture across MENA and Türkiye, with an authentic understanding of the artists, communities, movements, and cultural moments that shape audiences across the region.
* You think strategically and culturally, identifying where Spotify should show up and inspiring cross\-functional teams and partners around a compelling vision.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, influencing stakeholders, and collaborating across global and regional teams.
* You are fluent in English and Arabic. Turkish language proficiency is a strong advantage.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Dubai.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward\-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know \- we’re here to support you in any way we can.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description:
**Job Title**


Associate Director, Thought Leader Liaison, Ophthalmology, Northeast**Requisition**


JR000015963 Associate Director, Thought Leader Liaison, Ophthalmology, Northeast (Open)**Location**


New York, NY**Additional Locations**


Boston, MA, Columbus, OH, Newark, NJ**Job Description Summary**


Keenova is seeking a highly motivated and experienced individual to fill the role of Thought Leader Liaison. As a Thought Leader Liaison, you will play a crucial role in building and maintaining relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) within Ophthalmology.**Job Description**

**Summary**


The Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) is responsible for developing, managing, and engaging with Key Opinion Leaders throughout their assigned geography reporting to the Thought Leader Liaison Lead, reporting through Specialty Brands Marketing. He/she works closely with commercial colleagues and other staff to help build advocacy of Keenova’s products with KOLs. The Thought Leader Liaison also manages speakers, and captures KOL beliefs/insights, among other duties and responsibilities. This field\-based position requires an individual to work independently and effectively with limited direction. The position will be aligned to support the Immunology Business Unit and requires frequent travel within the US and periodic travel to the corporate office.

**Essential Functions**

**Strategic KOL Development and Management**

* Identify, cultivate, and maintain professional relationships with established and up\-and\-coming regional Key Opinion Leaders in targeted specialties.
* Support deep engagement of KOLs (ex. Navigating IDNs / Centers of Excellence, Professional Organizations)
* Identify, map, and manage relationships with key national associations and other large treatment facilities (includes the detailed mapping of referral patterns, key relationships, and influencers)
* Coordinate and lead one\-to\-one exchanges between Keenova team and KOLs across key initiatives and events.

**Congress / Key Event Management**

* Attend and manage brand activity at key regional and targeted national conferences (may encompass Rheumatology, Nephrology, Pulmonology, Ophthalmology).
* Manage overall regional sponsorships including working with organizations to secure sponsorships, and owning regional congress plan.
* Coordinate executive meetings with KOLs at national conferences.
* Support all necessary conference and speaker contract requirements in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with marketing to ensure all congress materials are delivered on time.

**Cross Functional Coordination**

* Work cross functionally to drive and develop aligned external engagement strategies across multiple cross functional teams including medical, training, marketing, and sales.
* Coordinate closely with the sales team to ensure alignment with conference KOL engagement plan as well as other KOL/account engagement.
* Provide market insights back to the marketing team and provide input into P2P development, advisory boards, and strategy.
* Be a resource for the Marketing team to develop board strategy, content, advisory recommendations, and attend advisory boards as appropriate.
* Coordinate with Market Development Manager and Speaker Programs Management on KOL Speaker bureau relationships including supporting speaker training.
* Provide insights summary from key congresses to the marketing team.

**Additional Information:**

* Business travel is regularly required (50% \- 65%)
* Willingness to work evenings and select weekends is required.
* Located near a hub airport is recommended.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotech or related industry in customer facing roles.
* 5\+ years of experience in thought leader engagement; medical affairs, marketing, sales/sales leadership or clinical experience.
* 3\+ years working within Ophthalmology.
* Experience developing and executing HCP key strategies.
* Proven ability to develop and execute KOL mapping and plans, as well as building KOL advocacy in the targeted therapeutic areas.
* Clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge and proficiency in complex disease states
* Existing relationships with KOLs (opinion leaders, centers of excellence etc.)
* Strong relationship building skills, with proven ability to build and maintain lasting relationships with KOLs and navigate strategic accounts (Integrated Delivery Networks, Academic Medical Centers, Centers of Excellence, etc.)
* Ability to exercise strong decision\-making skills and live up to the highest ethical standards.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including confident executive presence.
* Ability to build productive partnerships and collaborate effectively in a matrix organization.
* Ability to creatively address problems in an organized, systematic way
* High degree of organizational awareness, ability to connect the dots to understand all the interdependency and big picture.
* Exceptional critical thinking to help identify educational gaps, analyze findings, and make recommendations while articulating next steps.
* Strong understanding of legal and regulatory environment in pharmaceutical promotional activities, pharma industry guidelines and other compliance\-related issues
* Bachelor’s degree. MBA or advanced degree desired but not required.
* Extensive field travel required.


Locations\- Northeastern US


Keenova offers employees a Total Rewards package which includes competitive pay and benefits. To learn more about our Total Rewards benefits please visit: Keenova Careers \| Serve and Grow with Purpose \| Keenova

title: Senior Program Manager, Product Technology
description:
**Role:** Senior Program Manager, Product Technology
  

**Team:** Product Technology


**Scope:** Individual Contributor, P4


**Years of Experience:** 8\+


**Location:** Ventura, CA (Hybrid)


**Overview:**

Patagonia is in business to save our home planet, and Product is central to how we bring that mission to life. The Product Technology team enables the people, processes, and tools that help Patagonia create industry\-leading products known for performance, quality, durability, and responsibility. We are looking for a Program Manager to help advance this work by leading meaningful cross\-functional programs, strengthening portfolio execution and visibility, and creating the alignment, structure, and focus teams need to deliver outcomes that matter.


In this role, you will report to the Senior Director of Product Technology and guide mid\- to large\-scale initiatives that support key departmental and company priorities. You will work with a cross\-functional group of product teammates, multiple technology functions and domains, and business partners across Innovation, Design, DPC, Materials, Line Management, Marketing, Planning, Footprint, Creative, and others. You will help teams navigate complexity, clarify decisions, identify and resolve risks, improve ways of working, and connect day\-to\-day execution to Patagonia’s broader mission. We seek candidates who are energized by purposeful technology, collaborative problem solving, thoughtful program leadership, and the opportunity to shape the future of product creation at Patagonia.


**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead multiple high\-impact programs and/or projects that align to business goals, KPIs, and expected outcomes, while supporting development of integrated roadmaps and governance artifacts that help teams plan, execute, and measure progress.
* Drive program execution through established and evolving delivery frameworks, ensuring cross\-team commitment, clear handoffs, dependency resolution, and acceptance of key deliverables.
* Facilitate and continuously improve recurring portfolio reviews that assess project health, surface risks and dependencies, and keep teammates and stakeholders aligned on status, decisions, and next steps.
* Guide teams through change, ambiguity, and conflict by helping clarify issues, resolve tradeoffs, and develop mitigation plans that support execution across teams.
* Lead the development and execution of program and portfolio communications and performance reporting for stakeholder audiences, ensuring clarity and buy\-in on key decisions and next steps.
* Establish scalable program management standards, reusable playbooks, practices, and retrospectives that strengthen consistency across teams and help others apply effective project and program management methods.
* Partner with cross\-functional team members, managers, and key decision\-makers to align scope, priorities, and department\-level KPIs.
* Facilitate the annual planning process for team initiatives, including intake, scoping, prioritization, business case development, and submission.
* As an individual contributor, conduct your work in alignment with Patagonia’s Leadership Expectations *\-* Leading Self principles: *Build People \+ Teams, Drive Results, Demonstrate Good Judgement, and Champions Vision \+ Purpose.*

**Who You Are:**

* **Organized:** Uses structured planning, prioritization, documentation, reporting, task management, and communication practices to support project execution, visibility, and timely delivery.
* **Collaborative:** Builds strong, service\-oriented partnerships across teams and levels by leading with empathy, embracing clarity, aligning partners on next steps, and keeping cross\-functional work moving.
* **Curious:** Seeks to understand new things, asks thoughtful questions, and looks for practical and creative ways to solve problems.
* **Influential:** Drives alignment on complex, cross\-functional decisions by applying business and technical insight, reframing challenges, and guiding strategy across teams and priorities.
* **Team\-Oriented:** Embraces shared ownership, stays flexible and nimble as priorities evolve, and is willing to wear multiple hats or support varied work as needed to achieve the outcome.
* **Product\-Minded:** Appreciates the craft, quality, and responsibility behind Patagonia products while bringing a strong bias toward the people who create them and a genuine care for how teams, decisions, and outcomes support product creation.
* **Passionate:** Champions Patagonia’s mission to save our home planet and integrates this passion into all aspects of work.

**Experience You Bring:**

* 8\+ years of project and/or program design and management experience, including leading multiple high\-impact projects or programs and executing integrated roadmaps and governance artifacts.
* Demonstrated experience planning and delivering against complex and cross\-functional projects and/or programs utilizing established methodologies and techniques, including forced\-rank prioritization, resource planning, and timeline alignment to meet delivery goals.
* Experience developing and enforcing program and portfolio management standards, metrics, and reusable, scalable practices across teams.
* Proven ability to lead scaled risk assessments across teams, anticipate interdependencies, and develop and implement comprehensive mitigation plans.
* Strong communication and change\-management skills, including guiding stakeholder alignment and reporting for leadership audiences.
* Expertise with Microsoft Office applications and project/program management software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Azure DevOps, JIRA, ClickUp, FigJam).
* Experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar platforms to generate and analyze content, improve decision support, and streamline day\-to\-day workflows.
* Hands\-on working experience in digital workspace platforms and knowledge/record management tools including Confluence and SharePoint.
* Prior experience working in a consumer product/retail brand environment, preferably with product creation and/or product creation systems/tools experience.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.
* Experience leading projects or programs within the Apparel, Retail or Multi\-Channel industries is preferred.

**Hiring range:** $132,175 \- $147,725 USD Annual


At Patagonia, pay ranges are assigned to a job based on the location specific market median of similar jobs according to 3rd party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary for several reasons including skills/capabilities, experience, and available budget.


**Workplace Location Overview**

This position is Hybrid, with a standard schedule of Tuesday \- Thursday on\-site and remote work on other days. Occasional additional office visits may be required for team events or critical meetings.


**Benefits**

Patagonia offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement and leave of absence plans. Benefit plans may vary slightly depending on the nature of your employment.


**Employee Conduct**  

It is the responsibility of every employee to contribute to a positive, inclusive work environment through cooperative and professional interactions with co\-workers, customers and vendors.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other factors prohibited by law.

description:
**Sr. Director, Communications**
================================


This is a remote/hybrid position available to candidates residing in **ABC\-approved states**.


**HQ Location:** Austin, TX


**Reports to:** Chief Marketing Officer


**Our Mission**
---------------


At Action Behavior Centers (ABC), we help children diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) reach milestone moments. Compassionate care is at the heart of everything we do, and our highly trained clinicians deliver evidence\-based applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy tailored to each child’s unique needs.


Our autism services include diagnostic support, 1:1 individualized Early Intensive Behavioral Intervention (EIBI), Family Guidance, and school readiness programs across hundreds of centers in Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, and Texas. Because no family should have to wait for help, ABC offers immediate access to care.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Sr. Director, Communications is responsible for building and leading ABC's proactive earned media and public relations strategy, and for strengthening ABC's external reputation across two critical audiences: the families and their children in our care, and the teammates who provide that care. This role will help shape and amplify the stories that differentiate ABC, recognizing that positive family\-facing coverage also builds trust and pride among current and prospective teammates.


Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this role partners closely with the CMO and executive leadership on reputation strategy and crisis communications, bringing communications subject matter expertise and leading execution against a shared reputation strategy. This is a hands\-on leadership role for an entrepreneurial communicator who has led a communications function or owned significant PR / reputation responsibilities, is comfortable pitching press directly, and can move ABC from a reactive to a proactive posture on reputation.


The role oversees a team of two and partners closely with Marketing leadership, Recruiting, People Services, Clinical, Operations, and Legal. ABC's external digital marketing agency leads SEO, AIO, and paid media performance. This role owns PR and earned media strategy directly, partnering with ABC's existing content and creative teams within Marketing to amplify earned media wins across owned, social, and paid channels.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Earned Media \& Public Relations:**

  

* Help define and continually evolve ABC’s external narrative, identifying the stories, proof points, and areas of thought leadership ABC should own within autism care and ABA therapy
  
* Build and lead ABC's proactive earned media strategy, identifying, developing, and pitching stories that reinforce ABC's differentiation and reputation
  
* Serve as ABC's primary point of contact for press inquiries and media relationships
  
* Develop and drive thought leadership opportunities, including speaking engagements, bylines, and media placements, with a particular focus on ABC's clinical leadership
  
* Identify and develop human interest stories from families and clinicians that support both family\-facing and employer\-facing reputation goals
  
* Partner with Legal and executive leadership to develop messaging and manage communications around payer dynamics, ownership structure, industry scrutiny, and other externally sensitive topics
  
* Partner with ABC's existing content and creative teams on press release drafting and distribution; this role does not own day\-to\-day content production, webinars, e\-books, or organic social content, which remain owned by Integrated Marketing and Creative Services

### **Workplace Reputation \& Employer Brand Communications:**

  

* Own the communications strategy for ABC's workplace reputation across Glassdoor, Indeed, LinkedIn, and Reddit, setting priorities and messaging that the Communications team executes against
  
* Partner with Recruiting and People Services to align employer brand strategy with recruiting and retention goals, informed by ongoing sentiment and recruiting funnel data
  
* Monitor and interpret online sentiment, review platform trends, and social listening data to identify emerging reputation risks and opportunities
  
* Provide strategic recommendations on how to close gaps between ABC's intended employer brand and how it is currently experienced and discussed externally

### **Reputation \& Crisis Counsel:**

  

* Partner with the CMO and executive leadership on reputation risk, crisis preparedness, and issue anticipation
  
* Develop and maintain a crisis communications framework and response protocols in partnership with Legal and executive leadership
  
* Lead communications response during reputation\-critical moments, coordinating across Legal, Clinical, Operations, and executive leadership as needed

**Team Leadership:**
--------------------

  

* Directly manage the Director, Internal Communications, who continues to lead execution of teammate\-facing content, internal event communications, and employer review platform management, and who continues to manage and direct the Video Production Specialist day\-to\-day
  
* Set shared strategic priorities for internal event communications, particularly for events with reputation or media relevance (e.g., ABCaba, Summit, Action Weeks), while the Director, Internal Communications leads execution and directs the Video Production Specialist's contributions
  
* Provide coaching and support to help the team operate against clear strategic goals
  
* Represent the Communications function in marketing leadership planning and cross\-functional initiatives

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

  

* 12\+ years of progressive experience in public relations, corporate communications, or reputation management, including experience leading a communications team or owning a significant PR / reputation function; experience building or scaling a function is a plus
  
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to operate hands\-on, including personally developing story angles, pitching media, securing earned media placements and managing reporter relationships
  
* Experience advising senior executives on reputation strategy, thought leadership, and crisis communications
  
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated, reputation\-sensitive industry preferred
  
* Comfortable operating in a highly scaled, multi\-location, entrepreneurial environment
  
* Strong people leadership skills, with experience managing and developing a team
  
* Excellent judgment and discretion when handling sensitive internal and external communications
  
* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field

**Success Metrics:**
--------------------

  

* Volume and quality of earned media placements, with emphasis on priority national, regional, and industry outlets
  
* Growth in proactive vs. reactive earned media coverage
  
* Message pull\-through on ABC’s core reputation narratives
  
* Movement in employer review volume across Glassdoor and Indeed
  
* Growth in LinkedIn engagement and followership on employer brand and thought leadership content
  
* Movement in AI sentiment, including Reddit, tracked via Profound through our external agency
  
* Executive and clinical leadership thought leadership placements secured
  
* Speed and effectiveness of response to reputation\-critical moments

* Facebook: https://facebook.com/actionbehaviorcenters
